sections.heading: What is Monitoring in Spring REST services?

content.text: Monitoring refers to the continuous observation of the system’s performance and behavior, including uptime, response time, error rates, etc.
Example: Tracking response time of a /api/customers endpoint.

sections.heading: Why do we need to implement effective monitoring?
What is Logging in Spring REST?

content.text: Logging is the process of recording events and messages during application execution to help in debugging and diagnostics.
Example: Logging request/response of API calls or exceptions using Logger.info() or Logger.error().
A production-ready feature set that adds endpoints to monitor and manage your Spring Boot application.

items: Exposes application health, metrics, and environment data
Simplifies integration with monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana
